# Advanced Supermatter Handling
The Supermatter Crystal interacts strongly with the properties of its surrounding atmosphere.
Research indicates that atmospheric composition can influence the behaviour and output characteristics of the crystal.
Nanotrasen research archives contain numerous controlled experiments investigating these interactions.
Advanced experimentation should only be performed by qualified senior Atmospheric Technicians and Engineering personnel.
Experiments exceeding established safety parameters require appropriate authorization and risk assessment.
Unsafe experimentation may result in catastrophic consequences.
---

[color=orange]Nanotrasen Supermatter Research Division (SRD)[/color]

## Experiment SM-T1
[color=cyan]Experiment Lead:[/color]
NT-CE-TY-TY-TY
[color=cyan]Experiment Handler:[/color]
NT-AT-LS
[color=cyan]Experiment Authorization:[/color]
Junior Atmospheric Technician with Chief Engineer supervision.
[color=cyan]Testing Facility:[/color]
Nanotrasen Supermatter Research Facility [color=#000000]████████████[/color]
Facility contained a purpose-built experimental Supermatter chamber.
Chamber construction followed standard Nanotrasen engineering specifications.
---
[color=orange]Experiment Configuration[/color]
Chamber Design:
Purpose-built experimental chamber.
Chamber Size:
Standard issue dimensions.
Chamber Atmosphere:
Oxygen.
Cooling Atmosphere:
Oxygen.
Installed Cooling:
- Two sets of two Passive Vents. - Three radiator units per side.
Additional Cooling:
- Freezer temperature set to 150 K. - Direct passive vent connection.
Electrical Disturbance Countermeasures:
- Two grounding rods.
Safe Emitter Configuration:
Two emitters.
Experimental Emitter Configuration:
Six emitters.
---
[color=orange]Automation Configuration[/color]
Air Alarm automation for emitters is strongly advised.
Scrubber configuration:
Remove all gases except Oxygen.
---
[color=orange]Experiment Results[/color]
Stable operation achieved.
Moderate radiation output recorded.
Recommended harvesting configuration:
- Four emitters. - Six Radiation Collectors.
Alternative cooling atmospheres may be considered.
Nitrogen substitution demonstrated comparable stability.
---
[color=orange]Project Summary[/color]
Experiment demonstrated profitable power harvesting potential while maintaining acceptable operational stability.
Further testing approved under controlled conditions.

## Experiment SM-Z0
[color=cyan]Experiment Lead:[/color]
NT-CE-LS
[color=cyan]Experiment Handler:[/color]
NT-CE-LS
[color=cyan]Experiment Authorization:[/color]
Senior Atmospheric Technician clearance.
[color=cyan]Recommended Facilities:[/color]
Pre-existing Nanotrasen facilities:
- Facility designation [color=#000000]████████[/color] - Facility designation [color=#000000]████████[/color]
Both facilities contained modified or legacy Supermatter chamber layouts.
---
[color=orange]Experiment Configuration[/color]
Chamber Temperature:
Below 70 K.
Initial Chamber Pressure:
200 kPa Oxygen atmosphere.
Experimental Atmosphere:
Primarily Oxygen with approximately one tenth Nitrogen.
Cooling Atmosphere:
- Oxygen. - Tritium. - Nitrogen.
Cooling System:
- Three parallel radiator branches. - Six radiators installed per branch.
Additional Cooling:
- Three freezers connected directly through passive vent systems.
Overpressure Countermeasures:
- Inlet valve configured at 300 kPa. - Signal valve controlled by operational procedure.
Electrical Disturbance Countermeasures:
- Two grounding rods.
---
[color=orange]Automation Configuration[/color]
Required automation:
- Pressure floor monitoring. - Temperature-sensitive emitter activation.
Emitter activation should be separated into multiple stages.
---
[color=orange]Experiment Results[/color]
Safe Emitter Configuration:
Six emitters.
Estimated Safe Emitter Configuration:
Sixteen emitters.
Emitters used during testing:
Thirty-two emitters.
[color=red]CRITICAL EVENT:[/color]
Geiger monitoring equipment reached maximum measurement capacity.
Radiation shielding was increased immediately.
Maximum recorded output:
11.3 MW.
---
[color=orange]Project Summary[/color]
Experiment demonstrated exceptional profitability with significant operational risk.
Further experiments require consultation with affected departments.
